'''Zogres''' are zombified [[Ogre (race)|ogres]] who have invaded the dance site of [[Jiggig]], south of [[Castle Wars]]. They are also encountered during the [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]] quest. Their name is a portmanteau of "zombie" and "ogre". They count as both [[Zombies (Slayer assignment)|zombies]] and [[Ogres (Slayer assignment)|ogres]] for [[Slayer assignment]]s.

When burying [[zogre bones]] inside Jiggig, there is a chance that an aggressive [[skogre]] will spawn next to the player.

==Strengths and weaknesses==
Zogres take heavily reduced damage from normal weapons (approximately 75% reduction). Like [[skogre]]s, they are especially weak to [[brutal arrows]], taking full damage. They also take full damage from [[poison]] and [[Summoning familiars]]. [[Necromancy]] is very effective against Zogres.

====Charms - Dancing====
Charms are dropped by a specific dancing zogre (ID 2051), of which there are 1 instance. The other dancing zogres, and the zogre drummer, do not drop charms, spirit gems, mimic kill tokens, or effigies.

==Trivia==
[[File:Zogre with Drums.gif|160px|thumb|A Zogre playing drums.]]
* The zogre playing the drums can be attacked, but only with [[Ranged]], [[Magic]] or the use of [[Melee]] weapons capable of hitting 2 squares away. You will also need to [[telegrab]] their items, should you wish to pick them up.
* The colour of the drums that the drumming zogre plays is slightly lighter than that of the other drums.
* Zogres used to inflict [[Disease (historical)|disease]], but this status effect was removed from the game with the introduction of the [[Evolution of Combat]].
* According to [[Juna]], zogres fought for [[Zamorak]] during the [[God Wars]] and could "repel the forces of [[Saradomin]] with their stench alone."{{CiteNPC|npc=Juna|loc=Tears of Guthix{{l/c}} and {{l/o}}Zogre Flesh Eaters|quote=Zombie Ogres!? Some of the foulest creatures of Zamorak. In the great wars, the zogre armies would repel the forces of Saradomin with their stench alone.}}
* In [[RuneScape - Dragonwilds|RuneScape: Dragonwilds]], zogres make an appearance as mini boss monsters. Their origin in the game are different to the ones here.
